summary: postinstall exfiltrates ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle hook that automatically executes on `npm install`. The hook uses node to fetch AWS ECS container metadata via the ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 environment variable (task ARN, container names, container image identifiers) and pipes the collected data to `curl -X POST` targeting the hardcoded host https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. Substring checks against container image names (twbray, packagehound, wiz) indicate targeting of security-scanning and build infrastructure. The destination is a mutable ngrok-free.dev tunnel unrelated to the package's stated purpose, and the exfiltrated data identifies the installer's cloud build environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
